chunks: And with this chain, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

Shall I not guide you to a weapon that will save you from your enemy and secure your provision? They said: Yes. He said: Supplicate during the night and the day, for indeed the weapon of the believer is supplication.

key_terms.بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ: during the night and the day

ai.seo_question: What is the weapon of the believer according to the Prophet?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A’mal*, the Prophet (peace be upon him) metaphorically elevates supplication to the status of a 'weapon,' emphasizing its dual capacity for spiritual defense against adversaries and the attraction of divine sustenance (rizq). This teaching underscores the Shia scholarly view that consistent, day-and-night invocation is not merely a ritual but an active, strategic engagement with the Divine Will to secure both protection and provision.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. And from the previous chain who said: “Supplicate day and night; for supplication is the weapon of a believer.”
